runs.text: The paper gives no cost per kWh for the NFA cobalt-free pouch cell. Its NFA pouch cell results (the formation and C/3 cycling data for the pouch cell built with the NFA cathode) are reported only as cycling data, and the text makes no cost estimate for it. The only cost-per-kWh figure in the paper is the general DOE cell cost target, stated as

runs.quote: current manufacturing costs are about double this figure

runs.text: . These describe the target and industry costs generally, not the NFA pouch cell.
